VERSION 3.28.0.172
; qMarkable Home — a full-screen homepage shown when xochitl starts (boot or
; ~/xovi/start), not after waking from sleep. "Study" closes it (to My Files);
; reopen it from the calendar button in the My Files dock. The stock calendar
; (reMarkable Connect) dock button is hidden.
;
; Other mods add widgets to the homepage by filling the qmHomeWidgets slot:
;
;   SLOT qmHomeWidgets
;       INSERT {
;           Item { width: parent.width; height: 200 /* ... */ }
;
; Style: minimal. font.family: qmHome.mono, black on white, gray (#8c8c8c)
; for secondary text, square corners, no boxes or rules unless needed.
;       }
;   END SLOT
;
; Widgets are stacked in a Column (width: parent.width) inside a Flickable.
; Inside a widget, `root` is MainView's root and `qmHome` is the page.
;
; Requires: xovi + qt-resource-rebuilder. Firmware 3.28.0.172 only.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            // true at xochitl start-up; sleep/wake never recreates MainView
            property bool qmHomeVisible: true
        }

        TRAVERSE FocusScope#rootItem > FocusScope#viewRoot
            LOCATE BEFORE Item#connectivityNotifierContainer
            INSERT {
                Rectangle {
                    id: qmHome
                    objectName: "qmHome"
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    color: "white"
                    visible: root.qmHomeVisible && !root.passcodeHandler.userLocked

                    readonly property int margin: Math.round(width * 0.05)
                    // shared style for homepage widgets
                    readonly property string mono: "Noto Sans Mono"
                    readonly property double startedAt: Date.now()

                    function close() {
                        root.qmHomeVisible = false;
                    }

                    // Hide when a document is opened from elsewhere, but not
                    // when xochitl restores the last document during start-up.
                    Connections {
                        target: documentView.item
                        function onDocumentChanged() {
                            if (documentView.item && documentView.item.document
                                    && Date.now() - qmHome.startedAt > 20000) {
                                root.qmHomeVisible = false;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Swallow touches so nothing underneath reacts.
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                    }

                    Flickable {
                        id: qmHomeFlick
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: qmHomeColumn.height + qmHome.margin * 2
                        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                        flickableDirection: Flickable.VerticalFlick
                        clip: true

                        Column {
                            id: qmHomeColumn
                            x: qmHome.margin
                            y: qmHome.margin
                            width: qmHome.width - qmHome.margin * 2
                            spacing: 72

                            Item {
                                id: qmHomeHeader
                                width: parent.width
                                height: qmHomeTitle.height

                                function stamp() {
                                    var days = ["sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat"];
                                    var d = new Date();
                                    return Qt.formatDate(d, "yyyy-MM-dd") + "  " + days[d.getDay()];
                                }

                                Column {
                                    id: qmHomeTitle
                                    spacing: 6
                                    Text {
                                        text: "~/home"
                                        color: "black"
                                        font.family: qmHome.mono
                                        font.pixelSize: 56
                                        font.bold: true
                                    }
                                    Text {
                                        id: qmHomeDate
                                        color: "#8c8c8c"
                                        font.family: qmHome.mono
                                        font.pixelSize: 24
                                        text: qmHomeHeader.stamp()
                                        Connections {
                                            target: qmHome
                                            function onVisibleChanged() {
                                                if (qmHome.visible)
                                                    qmHomeDate.text = qmHomeHeader.stamp();
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                Text {
                                    id: qmHomeClose
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    anchors.top: parent.top
                                    anchors.topMargin: 14
                                    text: "study →"
                                    font.family: qmHome.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: 30
                                    font.bold: true
                                    color: "black"
                                    Rectangle {
                                        // underline doubles as press feedback
                                        anchors.left: parent.left
                                        anchors.right: parent.right
                                        anchors.top: parent.bottom
                                        anchors.topMargin: 4
                                        height: qmHomeCloseArea.pressed ? 6 : 2
                                        color: "black"
                                    }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        id: qmHomeCloseArea
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        anchors.margins: -24
                                        onClicked: qmHome.close()
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            ~{qmHomeWidgets}~
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/homescreen/qml/CreateMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE Item#root > Rectangle#primaryContainer > RowLayout#primaryLayout
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Action {
                id: qmHomeButton
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                Layout.fillHeight: true
                Layout.minimumWidth: height

                currentView: root.view
                popupOverlay: root.popupOverlay
                anchorTarget: root
                supportedViews: ["myfiles", "filter", "notebook-filter"]
                visible: qmHomeButton.supportedViews.includes(root.view)
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/calendar"
                onActionClicked: {
                    // MainView owns qmHomeVisible; walk up to it.
                    var p = root.parent;
                    while (p && p.qmHomeVisible === undefined)
                        p = p.parent;
                    if (p)
                        p.qmHomeVisible = true;
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Hide the stock calendar (reMarkable Connect integration) dock button so it
; isn't confused with the Home button.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/integrations/calendar/qml/CalendarActions.qml
    TRAVERSE Action#root
        REPLACE supportedViews WITH {
            supportedViews: []
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
